data.title: McDonald's bets on hand-breaded chicken, AI drive-throughs to fend off Burger King
data.description: McDonald's (MCD) is making a long-term bet on artificial intelligence, hand-breaded chicken, and a return of 90s-style restaurants to regain customers who left for other chains, like Burger King.
data.keywords: Burger King, McDonald's, artificial intelligence, McDonald's stock
